hotspots.title: Trump vs. Mainstream Media Conflict
hotspots.blurb: A federal judge ruled that the Trump administration's revocation of White House press credentials for CNN, Politico, and MS NOW was likely unconstitutional. The ruling sparked an intense showdown over First Amendment protections, presidential authority, and media access.
hotspots.affect: The direct judicial reversal of presidential action on press access triggers high constitutional drama, framing the confrontation as an existential clash between executive overreach and press freedom.

hotspots.title: Trump's High-Stakes Xi Jinping Summit
hotspots.blurb: President Trump welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping to Washington for a high-profile state visit featuring tech CEOs and diplomatic talks. While the administration extended trade truces, critics and lawmakers slammed the summit for failing to secure binding concessions.
hotspots.affect: The summit taps into deep economic anxiety, super-power rivalry fears, and geopolitical rivalry, keeping media attention focused on high-stakes national security and trade outcomes.

hotspots.title: Trump Administration's Policy Controversies and Legal Challenges
hotspots.blurb: The administration announced aggressive policy moves, including purging 760,000 people from Obamacare enrollments over alleged fraud and weighing a global diesel export ban. Meanwhile, states and environmental groups launched fresh lawsuits targeting offshore wind cancellations and benefits checks.
hotspots.affect: Combines government fraud-busting rhetoric with sharp social-benefit rollbacks and legal counterattacks, stirring strong moral panic and administrative anger across both sides.

hotspots.title: Trump's High-Stakes UN General Assembly Meetings
hotspots.blurb: At the United Nations General Assembly, President Trump warned of 'annihilation' regarding Iran while addressing global stability and Gaza reconstruction proposals. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy and foreign officials pushed back on foreign policy postures amid ongoing global conflicts.
hotspots.affect: Threats of war and nuclear escalation at a global forum create an existential threat register that commands acute alarm and geopolitical anxiety.

hotspots.title: Political Polarization and Trump's Power Dynamics
hotspots.blurb: Cultural and political clashes escalated around Trump's political influence, ranging from controversies over 'No MAGA' adoption rules at an animal rescue to GOP leadership calls for probes into Donald Trump Jr. Commentators and pollsters debated party loyalty, electoral durability, and midterm outlooks.
hotspots.affect: Cultural grievances, partisan tribalism, and internal party accountability battles fuel continuous baseline outrage across conservative and opposing media ecosystems.
